messages.author: 5a7e09d4a5dda681
messages.subject: macropod query
parts:
Hi all. I just have a quick question. has anyone or is anyone
currently doing any distance sampling work on macropods (esp smaller
ones). We are looking at distance sampling as an option to estimate our
Burrowing Bettong population as other techniques are useless due to
their trap happy nature. If not macropods then any medium sized
terrestrial mammals?
=20
Would like to get in contact with anyone that has.
=20
Kind regards
=20
Adam Bester
=20
